title: The Walking Dead
overview: Görev başında vurularak komaya giren şerif yardımcısı Rick Grimes, hastanede uyandığında medeniyetin bir zombi salgınıyla çöktüğünü görür ve ailesini bulup hayatta kalanlara liderlik etmeye çalışır.

episodes.name: Days Gone Bye
episodes.overview: Rick searches for his family after emerging from a coma into a world terrorized by the walking dead. Morgan and Duane, whom he meets along the way, help teach Rick the new rules for survival.

episodes.name: Guts
episodes.overview: Rick unknowingly causes a group of survivors to be trapped by walkers. The group dynamic devolves from accusations to violence, as Rick must confront an enemy far more dangerous than the undead.

episodes.name: Tell It to the Frogs
episodes.overview: Rick makes a decision to go back to Atlanta to retrieve the bag of guns and save a man's life. Lori and Shane must deal with the surprising return of someone they thought was dead.

episodes.name: Vatos
episodes.overview: Rick's mission to Atlanta is jeopardized when things go awry. Jim becomes unhinged in camp.

episodes.name: Wildfire
episodes.overview: Rick leads the group to the CDC after the attack. Jim must make a terrible life and death decision

episodes.name: TS-19
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are allowed into the CDC by a strange doctor. But all is not what it seems in their newfound haven.

episodes.name: What Lies Ahead
episodes.overview: After the CDC explosion, the survivors are still on the move when they encounter a herd of walkers that separates one of their own, leading them to a possible safe haven.

episodes.name: Bloodletting
episodes.overview: Coming to the aid of another, Rick discovers a possible safe haven. Shane must go on a dangerous mission to get badly needed medical supplies.

episodes.name: Save the Last One
episodes.overview: The group desperately awaits Shane's return. Shane finds himself trapped in a school, surrounded by the undead. Daryl and Andrea search for someone in the woods.

episodes.name: Cherokee Rose
episodes.overview: Shane makes a deadly sacrifice which leads to unusual behavior and self-distancing. The rest of the group tries to hang on somewhere between living to die and dying to live.

episodes.name: Chupacabra
episodes.overview: Glenn, the only one breaking barriers between both groups, knows far too much for his comfort level. Daryl finds a sign of life and, in his delirium, tries to make it back to the farm alive.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: Secrets are told and secrets are revealed. Hershel refuses to acknowledge the world’s new reality. Andrea comes out of her shell. Everyone is becoming more and more aware that “everything is food for something.”

episodes.name: Pretty Much Dead Already
episodes.overview: Hershel sets a deadline. All secrets are out in the open. Glenn stands up for himself and Shane takes charge.

episodes.name: Nebraska
episodes.overview: Rick and the others try to restore order in the aftermath of a terrible discovery. Hershel takes up an old habit and disappears, Rick and Glenn must follow him into town.

episodes.name: Triggerfinger
episodes.overview: Trapped, Rick, Hershel and Glenn fight to survive against new foes, both dead and alive. Shane finds Lori in danger on the road and makes it his mission to bring her back to the farm.

episodes.name: 18 Miles Out
episodes.overview: Rick and Shane come into conflict over the fate of an outsider. Andrea helps Hershel's youngest daughter face a crucial decision.

episodes.name: Judge, Jury, Executioner
episodes.overview: Rick sides with Shane on an important decision, causing Dale to worry that the group is losing its humanity. Carl's actions have unintended consequences on the group.

episodes.name: Better Angels
episodes.overview: The group learns that someone dangerous may be on the loose near the farm. As night falls, Rick, Shane, Daryl and Glenn comb the woods to handle the situation and keep the group safe.

episodes.name: Beside the Dying Fire
episodes.overview: Rick and Carl return from the woods to find the farm in jeopardy. The group is split up in the ensuing chaos. With things looking grim, Rick’s leadership is questioned.

episodes.name: Seed
episodes.overview: With the world growing increasingly more dangerous and Lori’s pregnancy advancing, Rick discovers a potentially safe haven. But first he must secure the premises, pushing his group to its limit.

episodes.name: Sick
episodes.overview: After a traumatic event, a life hangs in the balance. Complicating matters, the group must also deal with a potential threat to their new surroundings.

episodes.name: Walk with Me
episodes.overview: After witnessing an accident, Andrea and Michonne are introduced to a new community of survivors. As conflicts arise with their new acquaintances, a decision must be made.

episodes.name: Killer Within
episodes.overview: The group is severed and lives are put in jeopardy. In Woodbury, Merle has a request for the Governor.

episodes.name: Say the Word
episodes.overview: After another loss, Rick struggles. Michonne remains suspicious of the Governor as he throws a party with a unique twist for the people of Woodbury.

episodes.name: Hounded
episodes.overview: As Andrea grows closer to the Governor, Michonne makes a decision about Woodbury. Glenn and Maggie go on a run. Rick struggles.

episodes.name: When the Dead Come Knocking
episodes.overview: The Governor presses for information. A new guest arrives at the prison, forcing Rick's hand.

episodes.name: Made to Suffer
episodes.overview: Andrea steps up as the people of Woodbury are thrown into uncharted territory. At the prison, a new threat arises.

episodes.name: The Suicide King
episodes.overview: Rick tries to rescue a member of his group. Woodbury is in disarray after a recent attack. New guests raise concerns at the prison.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: As the group debates their next course of action, Rick wanders after a lost friend. Daryl and Merle question their choices. The Governor restores order in Woodbury and makes plans to punish those responsible.

episodes.name: I Ain't a Judas
episodes.overview: Their security threatened, Rick and the group must make a choice. With Woodbury in a police state, Andrea grows uneasy.

episodes.name: Clear
episodes.overview: Realizing they are heavily outgunned against the Governor's forces, Rick leads an expedition to get more weapons.

episodes.name: Arrow on the Doorpost
episodes.overview: In an effort to prevent any more deaths, Rick and the Governor meet to come up with a peace treaty.

episodes.name: Prey
episodes.overview: The Governor chases a dissenter who fled Woodbury. While the Governor is gone, a traitor tries to sabotage his upcoming plans.

episodes.name: This Sorrowful Life
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are faced with a serious problem. If they want a truce with the Governor, they will have to make a huge sacrifice.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Tombs
episodes.overview: Rick and the group have to seriously consider if the prison is worth defending as the Governor's impending attack looms over their heads.

episodes.name: 30 Days Without an Accident
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are as close to an ideal life as possible at the prison. Will they be able to hold on to humanity in the face of a new evil?

episodes.name: Infected
episodes.overview: As the group faces a brand new enemy, Rick and the others must fight to protect the livelihood they worked so hard to create at the prison.

episodes.name: Isolation
episodes.overview: As one group leaves the prison in search for supplies at a local college, those who stay must deal with recent losses while preserving what remains.

episodes.name: Indifference
episodes.overview: While on a supplies mission to a local college, members of the group run into multiple hurdles. Things at the prison are getting worse.

episodes.name: Internment
episodes.overview: Multiple enemies put pressure on Rick and the group. Could this finally be the breaking point for the survivors and the prison?

episodes.name: Live Bait
episodes.overview: A familiar face returns as each member of the group struggles to find his or her humanity in a world of constant threats.

episodes.name: Dead Weight
episodes.overview: A new and scary chapter is unfolding at a camp outside the prison. Will peace be attainable with the addition of new members?

episodes.name: Too Far Gone
episodes.overview: Just when everything started to calm down at the prison, Rick and his group now face imminent danger and destruction. This time, they might not win.

episodes.name: After
episodes.overview: As Rick deals with old wounds, members of the prison have to come to terms with their new environment and ask themselves if survival alone is enough.

episodes.name: Inmates
episodes.overview: The group encounters many obstacles in their quest to find stability and safety, but sometimes all they have to guide them is hope.

episodes.name: Claimed
episodes.overview: The group encounters many obstacles in their quest to find stability and safety, but sometimes all they have to guide them is hope.

episodes.name: Still
episodes.overview: Faced with the day-to-day survival of life outside shelter, a simple request by someone in the group leads to a bizarre but enlightening mission.

episodes.name: Alone
episodes.overview: As one group finds what may be an ideal shelter, another group comes to realize that the best protection comes from those around them.

episodes.name: The Grove
episodes.overview: After finding an idyllic place to establish a new shelter, the group starts to question whether it is possible to go back to the way things were.

episodes.name: Us
episodes.overview: However brutal some survivors believe they must be to stay alive, we get to see that faith can sometimes be the strongest survival tool.

episodes.name: A
episodes.overview: As multiple paths collide, Rick comes face to face with sheer brutality. Will he and the group have what it takes to survive?

episodes.name: No Sanctuary
episodes.overview: The true motives of the Terminans come to light when Rick and the others end up in a vulnerable situation.

episodes.name: Strangers
episodes.overview: With supplies running low and not knowing whether to trust the people around them, Rick leads a mission where the risk might not be worth the reward.

episodes.name: Four Walls and a Roof
episodes.overview: Rick and the group find themselves pitted against some very nasty people, but they might just have a plan to gain the upper hand.

episodes.name: Slabtown
episodes.overview: In this episode, we get to meet a whole group of other survivors, but what looks safe and nice on the outside has a bit of a dark side.

episodes.name: Self Help
episodes.overview: A new set of issues confront our group while on a mission. Will they be able to push through and survive these challenges? Or better yet, each other?

episodes.name: Consumed
episodes.overview: Cautiously, members of our group must venture into a familiar location on a heroic rescue mission. It's a huge stage, but so are the stakes.

episodes.name: Crossed
episodes.overview: Between holding down the church and going on a rescue mission, our group is spread pretty thin. Is this going to be the breaking point?

episodes.name: Coda
episodes.overview: Rick seeks a peaceful agreement when rules and morals are tossed aside by new enemies.

episodes.name: What Happened and What's Going On
episodes.overview: After the recent trials the group has faced, a slight detour could be the solution they've been searching for.

episodes.name: Them
episodes.overview: Life on the road has left the group beaten and beleaguered. Will they be able to trudge along? Are they even the same people they once were?

episodes.name: The Distance
episodes.overview: After a spectacular storm, Rick and the group meet a seemingly friendly person.

episodes.name: Remember
episodes.overview: Molding into a new lifestyle is proving difficult for the group. Has life on the road proven too treacherous to go back to who they once were?

episodes.name: Forget
episodes.overview: Rick and the group continue to acclimate to their new surroundings. Will they be able to go back to normalcy? Better yet, what is normal now?

episodes.name: Spend
episodes.overview: While trying to secure their new home, Rick and his group face many challenges, some life threatening. Is this really the utopia it seems to be?

episodes.name: Try
episodes.overview: The group realizes that sheltered life might not be possible as life within the walls starts to mimic life outside. Will these setbacks break Rick?

episodes.name: Conquer
episodes.overview: Daryl experiences trouble on a run while Rick and his group continue to feel like outsiders in Alexandria, where trouble is creeping into the gates.

episodes.name: First Time Again
episodes.overview: Rick and the others have a difficult time assimilating into Alexandria; a new threat arises that could bring the group closer together.

episodes.name: JSS
episodes.overview: When it appears that things are starting to normalize in the settlement, a new problem arises for the Alexandrians.

episodes.name: Thank You
episodes.overview: Rick and his group get caught up in a dangerous little town on the road back to Alexandria. Meanwhile, Daryl, Sasha and Abraham continue to lead away the remaining walkers away from the safe-zone.

episodes.name: Here's Not Here
episodes.overview: A new face appears; trust issues form.

episodes.name: Now
episodes.overview: Following a number of setbacks, the mood in Alexandria grows grim for the sheltered citizens.

episodes.name: Always Accountable
episodes.overview: Daryl, Abraham and Sasha encounter many obstacles and a new threat while trying to return to Alexandria.

episodes.name: Heads Up
episodes.overview: Alexandria is finally able to begin pulling itself back together; peace is embraced between the two groups.

episodes.name: Start to Finish
episodes.overview: After having a few moments of peace, trouble finds its way to Alexandria yet again. Only this time, the threat might be too big to defeat.

episodes.name: No Way Out
episodes.overview: With walkers inside the gates of Alexandria, Rick and the group are scared, outnumbered and things are only getting worse.

episodes.name: The Next World
episodes.overview: A simple scavenging run proves to be more tricky, when the survivors are not the only ones after a goldmine of supplies.

episodes.name: Knots Untie
episodes.overview: After Rick comes to the realization that Alexandria might not be as safe as he thought, decisions must be made about where to go from here.

episodes.name: Not Tomorrow Yet
episodes.overview: Rick and the group realize the only way to maintain the peace of Alexandria is to fight a new enemy. This time, though, our group might be outmatched.

episodes.name: The Same Boat
episodes.overview: With no hope of safety in Alexandria, Rick and his band of survivors soon discover a larger world with new dangers and new opportunities.

episodes.name: Twice as Far
episodes.overview: Two separate groups leave Alexandria for supplies, and while both worry over the future of the community, they will face immediate danger.

episodes.name: East
episodes.overview: When someone goes missing in Alexandria, the community goes on alert, and search parties venture out.

episodes.name: Last Day on Earth
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of a tragic blow, Eugene falls captured by Dwight, a member of the Saviors, whom are hell bent on getting even with Alexandria, Negan teaches Rick and co a brutal lesson, which shows that Rick and co finally have something to fear.

episodes.name: The Day Will Come When You Won't Be
episodes.overview: Last season ended with Rick and our group kneeling helplessly before Negan and his group; what Negan does will haunt those who survive forever.

episodes.name: The Well
episodes.overview: For a number of familiar faces, a new, well-established community seems too good to be true.

episodes.name: The Cell
episodes.overview: A new group of survivors seem to have it all in their impressive community; however, there is a price.

episodes.name: Service
episodes.overview: The remaining members of the group try to keep it together in Alexandria; they receive a sobering visit.

episodes.name: Go Getters
episodes.overview: Saddled with grief and surrounded by enemies, members of the group try to find safety at the Hilltop before it's too late.

episodes.name: Swear
episodes.overview: Someone stumbles upon a brand new society, and this society is unlike anything seen before.

episodes.name: Sing Me a Song
episodes.overview: A deeper look at the Sanctuary and the world of the Saviors; members of Alexandria look for supplies.

episodes.name: Hearts Still Beating
episodes.overview: Negan's unwelcome visit to Alexandria continues as other members scavenge for supplies; things quickly spin out of control.

episodes.name: Rock in the Road
episodes.overview: Rick is introduced to a new community.

episodes.name: New Best Friends
episodes.overview: While searching for a missing Alexandrian, Rick and his group encounter a mysterious collective, its inhabitants unlike any they have come across.

episodes.name: Hostiles and Calamities
episodes.overview: An Alexandrian discovers they must navigate the mysterious, confusing and terrifying world within the Saviors' compound.

episodes.name: Say Yes
episodes.overview: The group scavenges for supplies; back in Alexandria, someone must make a morally challenging decision.

episodes.name: Bury Me Here
episodes.overview: Things do not go as planned when a group of Kingdommers delivers goods to the Saviors during a routine supply drop-off.

episodes.name: The Other Side
episodes.overview: The Saviors visit the Hilltop unexpectedly, surprising everyone, with plans of taking more than supplies.

episodes.name: Something They Need
episodes.overview: A group of Alexandrians embarks on a journey; one member of the group must make a heartbreaking decision.

episodes.name: The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
episodes.overview: The stakes continue to grow higher as paths cross; the group enacts an intricate plan.

episodes.name: Mercy
episodes.overview: Rick and his group, along with the Kingdom and Hilltop, have banded together to bring the fight to Negan and the Saviors.

episodes.name: The Damned
episodes.overview: The plan involving Alexandrians, Kingdommers and Hilltoppers unfolds; as Rick continues to fight, he encounters a familiar face.

episodes.name: Monsters
episodes.overview: Conflict with the Saviors leads to unintended consequences for the Hilltop, the Kingdom, and Alexandria; morality proves tricky in wartime.

episodes.name: Some Guy
episodes.overview: A new weapon in the Savior arsenal proves to be a giant hurdle as fighting continues between Rick's forces and those of the Saviors.

episodes.name: The Big Scary U
episodes.overview: A close look at Negan and the lives of the Saviors during the conflict through a familiar set of eyes.

episodes.name: The King, the Widow, and Rick
episodes.overview: With things looking up for Rick and the group, an argument breaks out at the Hilltop; the consequences of the decision are life versus death.

episodes.name: Time for After
episodes.overview: Negan has to enlist the help of his lieutenants in solving a huge issue facing the Sanctuary; Rick and the group continue to enact the plan.

episodes.name: How It's Gotta Be
episodes.overview: Every story and battle from the first half of the season comes crashing together in this action-packed, emotional mid-season finale.

episodes.name: Honor
episodes.overview: Rick faces new difficulties after a battle. Meanwhile, the fight continues in other communities as core members face hard decisions.

episodes.name: The Lost and the Plunderers
episodes.overview: Groups unite their forces and converge on the Hilltop; Aaron and Enid search for allies.

episodes.name: Dead or Alive Or
episodes.overview: Daryl finds himself in bad company as his group heads to the Hilltop; Gabriel's faith gets tested.

episodes.name: The Key
episodes.overview: Hilltop's leadership faces a difficult dilemma after the arrival of unexpected visitors; Rick comes face to face with an adversary.

episodes.name: Do Not Send Us Astray
episodes.overview: Trouble arises when unexpected visitors arrive at the Hilltop and the community is thrust into action; heartbreaking discoveries are made.

episodes.name: Still Gotta Mean Something
episodes.overview: A Heaps prisoner makes a discovery; Carol searches for someone in the nearby forest; Rick and Morgan find themselves in the company of strangers.

episodes.name: Worth
episodes.overview: With the threat of the Saviors still looming, Aaron continues searching for allies; Daryl and Rosita take action and confront an old friend.

episodes.name: Wrath
episodes.overview: The communities join forces in the last stand against the Saviors as all-out war unfolds.

episodes.name: A New Beginning
episodes.overview: Rick and his group make a risky run into Washington, D.C. to search for artifacts they will need to build the civilization he and Carl envisioned.

episodes.name: The Bridge
episodes.overview: The communities join forces to restore a bridge that will facilitate communication and trade; someone is gravely injured at the construction site.

episodes.name: Warning Signs
episodes.overview: Rick's vision for the future is threatened by a mysterious disappearance that divides the work camp where the communities are building a bridge.

episodes.name: The Obliged
episodes.overview: Rick's vision of a civilized future is threatened by a sudden reckoning with past sins that remain unavenged and unforgiven.

episodes.name: What Comes After
episodes.overview: Rick is forced to face the past as he struggles to maintain the safety of the communities and protect the future he and Carl envisioned.

episodes.name: Who Are You Now?
episodes.overview: The Survivors encounter unfamiliar faces outside the safety of their community's walls and must decide whether or not this new group can be trusted.

episodes.name: Stradivarius
episodes.overview: Carol seeks out an old friend living alone in a wilderness teeming with walkers; survivors make the perilous trek to a new home.

episodes.name: Evolution
episodes.overview: A small rescue mission braves a dangerous herd in their hunt for a missing comrade, only to discover a surprising threat that could doom them all.

episodes.name: Adaptation
episodes.overview: The communities thought they could build a better future separately, but the recent loss of one of their own drives them to band together; new leaders rise when a disturbing and dangerous threat is unmasked; an escaped captive revisits his past.

episodes.name: Omega
episodes.overview: Daryl learns more about the masked tribe's leader; a search begins for two missing friends.

episodes.name: Bounty
episodes.overview: The savage group led by Alpha confronts the Hilltop in a harrowing attempt to retrieve her daughter. A supply run for the Kingdom turns into a dangerous quest.

episodes.name: Guardians
episodes.overview: While one community struggles to ease tensions that threaten to divide from within, the true nature of another group comes into focus; a mission to rescue a friend has deadly consequences.

episodes.name: Chokepoint
episodes.overview: Daryl's daring rescue mission forces Alpha to unleash a group of her own to retrieve what belongs to her, even if the price is paid in blood; the Kingdom's plans to reunite the communities are put in jeopardy.

episodes.name: Scars
episodes.overview: An outsider's arrival forces Alexandria to rehash devastating old wounds; eye-opening secrets from the past are revealed.

episodes.name: The Calm Before
episodes.overview: The fair at the Kingdom is underway, with all four communities coming together in celebration for the first time in years; while some pacts are renewed, other deals will come at a much steeper price.

episodes.name: The Storm
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of an overwhelming loss, the communities must brave a ferocious blizzard; as one group deals with an enemy from within, another is forced to make a life or death decision.

episodes.name: Lines We Cross
episodes.overview: The Oceanside group continues to train in case the Whisperers return. Tensions are high as our heroes struggle to hold onto their concept of civilization.

episodes.name: We Are the End of the World
episodes.overview: The origins of Alpha and Beta are revealed in a flashback; Alpha tries to help Lydia prepare for their journey with the dead; the Whisperers create herds.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.overview: Alexandria is overcome with paranoia as the threat of the Whisperers looms; Carol struggles over her desperate urge for revenge.

episodes.name: Silence the Whisperers
episodes.overview: Negan feels the brunt of the Alexandrians' fears as their paranoia of the Whisperers grows; a safety issue catches the group off guard at Hilltop.

episodes.name: What It Always Is
episodes.overview: Supplies go missing from Hilltop; Negan is idolized by an Alexandrian; Ezekiel holds a secret.

episodes.name: Bonds
episodes.overview: Carol teams up with Daryl as they embark on a mission together; Siddiq finds it harder than expected to unravel a mystery.

episodes.name: Open Your Eyes
episodes.overview: Daryl becomes uncomfortable when Carol starts going past his boundaries; Alpha and Beta share reservations about a certain individual.

episodes.name: The World Before
episodes.overview: A fight causes tensions in Oceanside while the Alexandrians set out on a high-stakes mission.

episodes.name: Squeeze
episodes.overview: The group must figure out how to get out of a precarious situation.

episodes.name: Stalker
episodes.overview: The group must defend Alexandria from a threatening outside force.

episodes.name: Morning Star
episodes.overview: The Whisperers are coming for Hilltop. After Daryl and Lydia's encounter with Alpha, the communities must decide whether to run or fight. Meanwhile, Eugene's communication with Stephanie gets complicated.

episodes.name: Walk with Us
episodes.overview: Negan helps the Whisperers and Alpha launch an attack against the Hilltop.

episodes.name: What We Become
episodes.overview: Michonne takes Virgil back to his island to find his family; in exchange, Virgil offers weapons.

episodes.name: Look at the Flowers
episodes.overview: Everyone reckons with the aftermath of the Hilltop fire; Eugene leads a trip to meet Stephanie.

episodes.name: The Tower
episodes.overview: The communities prepare to participate in the Whisperer War's last battle; Eugene's group comes face-to-face with Princess.

episodes.name: A Certain Doom
episodes.overview: Beta engages the final battle of the Whisperer War.

episodes.name: Home Sweet Home
episodes.overview: Maggie has returned with a story she is not ready to share, even when her past catches up to her. Negan's safety is at stake again. Daryl and Maggie fight an unseen and unknown threat.

episodes.name: Find Me
episodes.overview: An adventure for Daryl and Carol turns sideways when they come across an old cabin. It takes Daryl back to the years when he left the group after Rick disappeared as he relives a time that only the apocalypse could manifest.

episodes.name: One More
episodes.overview: Gabriel and Aaron search for food and supplies to bring back to Alexandria. Small tragedies lead to bigger tragedies as faith is broken and optimism is fragmented when they are put to the ultimate test.

episodes.name: Splinter
episodes.overview: Eugene, Ezekiel, Yumiko, and Princess are captured and separated. Princess struggles with memories of her traumatic past and tries to escape one way or another with the help of Ezekiel.

episodes.name: Diverged
episodes.overview: Daryl and Carol come to a fork in the road and head their separate ways. Each going into their own type of survival mode, the easiest of challenges become much harder. Will their individual journeys be the tipping point needed to mend their friendship or is the distance between them permanent?

episodes.name: Here's Negan
episodes.overview: Carol takes Negan on a journey, hoping to minimize the increasing tension. Negan reflects on the events that led him to this point and comes to a conclusion about his future.

episodes.name: Acheron: Part 1
episodes.overview: Returning to Alexandria from a critical food mission, the group realizes it isn't enough. Maggie proposes a new plan, potentially a suicide mission. What choice do they have? They must find more food for all their people in order to survive and efficiently rebuild Alexandria. If they don't, Alexandria falls, taking them down with it. Once on the road, a violent storm erupts forcing them underground into a subway tunnel. As nerves fray and suspicions increase, chaos ensues. The terror is relentless as our people get a glimpse of what Maggie and her group endured prior to returning to Alexandria. Meanwhile, those captured by the strange soldiers are relocated to another undisclosed location.

episodes.name: Acheron: Part 2
episodes.overview: The group discovers a member did not make it to safety inside the subway car. Surrounded by walkers, going back out into the tunnel to search is a guaranteed death wish. All eyes are on Negan as the rule of survival shifts. It is no longer No Man Left Behind. The motto now is We Keep Going. With very little ammo and energy remaining, the group must ready themselves as the walkers have found a way inside the subway train. Meanwhile, Daryl is in his own intense hellish situation trying to find Dog and finding more than he expected; and Yumiko challenges the process at the Commonwealth outpost, which threatens her future and that of Eugene, Ezekiel, and Princess.

episodes.name: Hunted
episodes.overview: Maggie's mission team gets separated and hunted by the Reapers; Carol, Rosita, Magna and Kelly attempt to catch horses for Alexandria; Judith, RJ, Hershel and Gracie cope with their parents going away.

episodes.name: Rendition
episodes.overview: Daryl and Dog get captured by the Reapers; they are taken to the Meridian and reconnect with a familiar figure from their past.

episodes.name: Out of the Ashes
episodes.overview: Alexandrians encounter Hilltop squatters; Eugene's group undergoes orientation at the Commonwealth.

episodes.name: On the Inside
episodes.overview: Connie and Virgil hide in a house; Pope tests Daryl's loyalty; Kelly searches for Connie.

episodes.name: Promises Broken
episodes.overview: Maggie learns a survival tactic from Negan; Eugene's group clears walkers; Daryl hunts with Leah.

episodes.name: For Blood
episodes.overview: The Reapers defend Meridian from a herd; Alexandrians protect themselves from walkers in a storm.

episodes.name: No Other Way
episodes.overview: Daryl, Maggie, Gabriel, Negan and Elijah battle the Reapers for food; Aaron and the Alexandrians must survive a storm.

episodes.name: New Haunts
episodes.overview: The heroes experience Halloween in the Commonwealth; Daryl and Rosita undergo military training led by Mercer; Carol investigates Ezekiel's medical condition.

episodes.name: Rogue Element
episodes.overview: Eugene looks for Stephanie after she mysteriously goes missing; Connie investigates a story on Trooper Davis; Carol helps Hornsby with a labor dispute at a drug farm.

episodes.name: The Lucky Ones
episodes.overview: Governor Pamela Milton tours Alexandria, Oceanside, and Hilltop. Eugene processes Max's story.

episodes.name: Warlords

episodes.overview: Adam holds Martha captive in 2020. On the day of the apocalypse, an increasingly frantic Martha begs Bartosz for his help.

episodes.name: Zwischen der Zeit
episodes.overview: Across three centuries, Winden's residents continue their desperate quest to alter their fate and save their loved ones.

episodes.name: Das Paradies
episodes.overview: Claudia reveals to Adam how everything is connected — and how he can destroy the knot.

title: Loki
overview: Avengers: Endgame olayları sırasında Tesseract'ı çalarak zaman çizgisinden kaçan Fesatlık Tanrısı Loki, Zaman Varyansı Otoritesi (TVA) tarafından yakalanır ve çoklu evreni tehdit eden bir varyantı durdurmakla görevlendirilir.

episodes.name: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: Loki, the God of Mischief, finds himself out of time and in an unusual place and forced — against his godly disposition — to cooperate with others. Welcome to the TVA, y'all!

episodes.name: The Variant
episodes.overview: Mobius puts Loki to work investigating The Variant, but not everyone at the TVA is thrilled to be working alongside The God of Mischief.

episodes.name: Lamentis
episodes.overview: Loki finds himself trapped in an apocalypse with a dead TemPad and the last person he wants by his side: the Loki Variant, Sylvie. Now the two must find their way off of the doomed moon before complete annihilation.

episodes.name: The Nexus Event
episodes.overview: Loki and Sylvie find their way off the Lamentis-1 mere moments before complete annihilation. Now, the question on everyone's mind, especially those in charge of the TVA — how did these two variants create a Nexus Event in the face of an apocalypse?

episodes.name: Journey Into Mystery
episodes.overview: Upon discovering the Time Keepers aren't real, Judge Renslayer prunes Loki with the Time Stick. Now in an unknown land surrounded by variant Lokis, they urge him to follow them. Meanwhile, turning on the judge, Sylvie demands to be told everything about the TVA.

episodes.name: For All Time. Always.
episodes.overview: Loki and Sylvie arrive the Citadel at the End of Time. Will they finally discover who is behind the Time Variance Authority?

episodes.name: Ouroboros
episodes.overview: Loki finds himself lost to time and torn, quite literally, between past, present and future.

episodes.name: Breaking Brad
episodes.overview: With the TVA on the verge of a temporal meltdown, Loki & Mobius will stop at nothing to find Sylvie.
Loki & Mobius go on the hunt to find everyone's favorite cartoon clock as they try to save the TVA.

episodes.name: Heart of the TVA
episodes.overview: The TVA's Loom nears catastrophic failure but Loki, Mobius and Sylvie have a He Who Remains variant.

episodes.name: Science/Fiction
episodes.overview: Loki traverses dying timelines in attempt to find his friends, but Reality is not what it seems.

episodes.name: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: The clock is ticking in the season finale which finds Loki and Sylvie on a date with destiny.

title: The Mandalorian
overview: Galaktik İmparatorluk'un çöküşünden sonra Yeni Cumhuriyet'in otoritesinden uzak dış halkalarda yaşayan yalnız bir Mandaloryalı ödül avcısı, Güç'e duyarlı gizemli bir çocuğu korumak için tüm galaksiyi karşısına alır.

episodes.name: Chapter 1: The Mandalorian
episodes.overview: A Mandalorian bounty hunter tracks a target for a well-paying client.

episodes.name: Chapter 2: The Child
episodes.overview: Target in-hand, the Mandalorian must now contend with scavengers.

episodes.name: Chapter 3: The Sin
episodes.overview: The battered Mandalorian returns to his client for reward.

episodes.name: Chapter 4: Sanctuary
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian teams up with an ex-soldier to protect a village from raiders.

episodes.name: Chapter 5: The Gunslinger
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian helps a rookie bounty hunter who is in over his head.

episodes.name: Chapter 6: The Prisoner
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian joins a crew of mercenaries on a dangerous mission.

episodes.name: Chapter 7: The Reckoning
episodes.overview: An old rival extends an invitation for The Mandalorian to make peace.

episodes.name: Chapter 8: Redemption
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian comes face-to-face with an unexpected enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter 9: The Marshal
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian is drawn to the Outer Rim in search of others of his kind.

episodes.name: Chapter 10: The Passenger
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian must ferry a passenger with precious cargo on a risky journey.

episodes.name: Chapter 11: The Heiress
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian braves high seas and meets unexpected allies.

episodes.name: Chapter 12: The Siege
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian rejoins old allies for a new mission.

episodes.name: Chapter 13: The Jedi
episodes.overview: Following Bo-Katan's advice, the Mandalorian travels to Corvus to find the mysterious Ahsoka Tano.

episodes.name: Chapter 14: The Tragedy
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and Child travel to an ancient site.

episodes.name: Chapter 15: The Believer
episodes.overview: To move against the Empire, the Mandalorian needs the help of an old enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter 16: The Rescue
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and his allies attempt a daring rescue.

episodes.name: Chapter 17: The Apostate
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian begins an important journey.

episodes.name: Chapter 18: The Mines of Mandalore
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu explore the ruins of a destroyed planet.

episodes.name: Chapter 19: The Convert
episodes.overview: On Coruscant, former Imperials find amnesty in the New Republic.

episodes.name: Chapter 20: The Foundling
episodes.overview: Din Djarin returns to the hidden Mandalorian covert.

episodes.name: Chapter 21: The Pirate
episodes.overview: The people of Nevarro need protection from rampant pirate attacks.

episodes.name: Chapter 22: Guns for Hire
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian visits an opulent world.

episodes.name: Chapter 23: The Spies
episodes.overview: Survivors come out of hiding.

episodes.name: Chapter 24: The Return
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and his allies confront their enemies.

title: WandaVision
overview: Süper güçlere sahip Wanda Maximoff ve Vision, banliyödeki ideal sitcom hayatlarının ardında gizlenen gerçekliğin yavaş yavaş çatlamasıyla karanlık sırları keşfetmeye başlar.

episodes.name: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience
episodes.overview: Wanda and Vision struggle to conceal their powers during dinner with Vision's boss and his wife.

episodes.name: Don't Touch That Dial
episodes.overview: Wanda Maximoff and Vision bring illusion and glamour to Westview's talent show fundraiser.

episodes.name: Now in Color
episodes.overview: After Wanda's pregnancy takes an unexpected turn, new friend Geraldine steps in to assist. Meanwhile, Vision gets closer to some of his Westview neighbors.

episodes.name: We Interrupt This Program
episodes.overview: We travel to Westview with Captain Monica Rambeau and her team of S.W.O.R.D. agents as they try to figure out what's going on.

episodes.name: On a Very Special Episode…
episodes.overview: On a very special episode of WandaVision , Wanda and Vision deal with their changing and expanding family — in more ways than one!

episodes.name: All-New Halloween Spooktacular!
episodes.overview: Halloween has arrived in Westview! While Wanda and Uncle Pietro take Billy and Tommy trick-or-treating, Vision ventures out to the far side of town on a hunch.

episodes.name: Breaking the Fourth Wall
episodes.overview: Wanda decides to take some much needed "me time," while Vision encounters detours along the way back home.

episodes.name: Previously On
episodes.overview: Forced by Agatha Harkness, Wanda Maximoff must relive past memories as she charts the steps that led her to Westview.

episodes.name: The Series Finale
episodes.overview: Wanda and Vision fight to save Westview.

title: Daredevil
overview: Çocukken geçirdiği kaza sonucu görme yetisini kaybeden ancak diğer duyuları insanüstü seviyede gelişen Matt Murdock, gündüzleri avukat, geceleri ise Hell's Kitchen sokaklarında maskeli kahraman Daredevil olarak adalet arar.

episodes.name: Into the Ring
episodes.overview: Matt Murdock, a Marvel Comics hero who's a lawyer by day but fights the bad guys at night to avenge the murder of his father, a boxer. But what sets Matt apart from most superheroes isn't his back story it's his handicap. Matt is blind, the result of a childhood accident that may have removed his ability to see but gifted him with heightened senses of touch, taste, hearing and smell.

episodes.name: Cut Man
episodes.overview: As Claire nurses Matt back to health, she discovers that her patient is much more than an ordinary man. Meanwhile, Matt recalls the events that led to him becoming Daredevil.

episodes.name: Rabbit in a Snowstorm
episodes.overview: Murdock and Foggy take on a mysterious wealthy client, but Murdock is convinced that there's more to the case than just the facts.

episodes.name: In the Blood
episodes.overview: Daredevil goes after the Russians who have abducted Claire. Meanwhile, Wilson goes on a dinner date with Vanessa.

episodes.name: World on Fire
episodes.overview: Fisk moves forward with plans that threaten to rip Hell's Kitchen apart. Murdock and Foggy take on a case helping tenants victimized by a slumlord.

episodes.name: Condemned
episodes.overview: Daredevil finds himself trapped in the fallout of Fisk's plan to take control of Hell's Kitchen. Ben Urich digs closer to the truth.

episodes.name: Stick
episodes.overview: An important figure from Murdock's past reemerges seeking his help to battle a new enemy threatening Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.name: Shadows in the Glass
episodes.overview: While Murdock, Foggy and Karen's mission becomes clearer, Fisk's world spins further out of control in his battle for Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.name: Speak of the Devil
episodes.overview: When Fisk gains the upper hand, the goal to destroy him becomes even more difficult, while Daredevil faces his own demons.

episodes.name: Nelson v. Murdock
episodes.overview: Murdock and Foggy's relationship is put to the ultimate test while a new enemy against Fisk emerges.

episodes.name: The Path of the Righteous
episodes.overview: Fisk and Murdock wrestle with the consequences of their chosen paths, while Ben and Karen get closer to Fisk's true past.

episodes.name: The Ones We Leave Behind
episodes.overview: Fisk seeks revenge while Karen is haunted by recent events. Daredevil makes a startling discovery about Fisk's financing.

episodes.name: Daredevil
episodes.overview: In the season finale, a boxed-in Fisk and a desperate Murdock, Foggy and Karen are forced to play their end games.

episodes.name: Bang
episodes.overview: The New York City underworld is up for grabs after Wilson goes to jail. A new party arrives in town to kill all of the mobsters, and Daredevil goes after them.

episodes.name: Dogs to a Gunfight
episodes.overview: Matt recovers from the Punisher's head shot, while Foggy and Karen arrange a deal with DA Samantha Reyes to get their client Grotto into WITSEC. However, Reyes needs Grotto to do one thing before she agrees.

episodes.name: New York's Finest
episodes.overview: Punisher has a discussion with a captive Daredevil about what they do and why. Meanwhile, Reyes threatens to shut down Nelson & Murdoch, and Karen sets out to get something on the DA. At the hospital ER, Foggy turns to Claire for help locating a missing Matt.

episodes.name: Penny and Dime
episodes.overview: An Irish mobster seeking revenge for Punisher killing his son--and the $1.2 million that Punisher stole--arrives in Hell's Kitchen. Meanwhile, Karen gets a lead on Frank Castle and investigates his connection to the homicidal vigilante prowling the city.

episodes.name: Kinbaku
episodes.overview: While Matt deals with Elektra in the present, he remembers what happened between them ten years ago. Meanwhile, Blake pressures Foggy for information on the Grote case, and Karen digs into Frank's background when she suspects coverup.

episodes.name: Regrets Only
episodes.overview: Elektra convinces Matt to let her help eliminate the Yakuza from New York City. Meanwhile, Nelson & Murdoch agree to enter a plea for Frank, and Karen learns more about their new client.

episodes.name: Semper Fidelis
episodes.overview: Foggy tries to defend Frank in court, despite Matt's continuing absence as Daredevil teams up with Elektra to find out what the Japanese are up to.

episodes.name: Guilty as Sin
episodes.overview: Foggy tries to mount Frank's legal defense despite Matt's ongoing absence. Meanwhile, Matt is reunited with an old friend and discovers his connection to Elektra... and the secret of the Hand.

episodes.name: Seven Minutes in Heaven
episodes.overview: Wilson arranges for Frank to meet him in prison. Meanwhile, Foggy tries to keep the law firm afloat but discovers that Matt isn't interested.

episodes.name: The Man in the Box
episodes.overview: People connected to the Central Park massacre are brutally gunned down, but Karen suspects that someone is setting Punisher up for a fall. Meanwhile, Matt convinces Claire to look after the Hand prisoners, but it turns out that they may not be as helpless as they appear.

Karen escapes her protective custody and meets with Frank, who is on the trail of Blacksmith. Meanwhile, Daredevil's own search for the elusive drug lord takes him to Madame Gao, who warns that his quest won't end well.

episodes.name: The Dark at the End of the Tunnel
episodes.overview: After the Hand abduct Stick, Daredevil traces them to their lair beneath the city. Meanwhile, Karen continues her investigation into Frank's background after his death.

episodes.name: A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen
episodes.overview: Daredevil battles the Hand--with Elektra at his side--and discovers that the price of victory may prove too high to accept.

episodes.name: Resurrection
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of the battle with the Hand, Matt loses part of his hearing and heals with the aid of the nuns at the orphanage where he grew up. Meanwhile, Foggy and Karen try to move on with their lives, and an FBI agent reaches out to Fisk with surprising results.

episodes.name: Please
episodes.overview: While Matt suffers a crisis of faith, Fisk finds himself the target of inmates trying to kill him because he's become a snitch.

episodes.name: No Good Deed
episodes.overview: The FBI move Fisk to a $20 million hotel penthouse to protect him, but the public soon learns of it. Matt considers what to do next, while Karen learns of a connection between Fisk and the Kazimis.

episodes.name: Blindsided
episodes.overview: Matt goes prison using Foggy's stolen bar card to get information on Fisk from the Albanians, while Foggy and Marci settle on the best way for Foggy to protect himself from Fisk.

episodes.name: The Perfect Game
episodes.overview: Fisk analyzes Dex's past while looking for a scapegoat to take the public's eye off of him. Meanwhile, Ray questions Foggy and Karen about their involvement with CGI and Wesley's disappearance.

episodes.name: The Devil You Know
episodes.overview: Fisk makes Dex an offer, while Foggy negotiates a deal with the FBI for Matt to turn himself in.... if they'll listen to an exonerating witness first.

episodes.name: Aftermath
episodes.overview: Ray begins to suspect that Fisk has been playing him as well as the entire FBI. Meanwhile, Matt, Karen, and Foggy each deal with the aftermath of the Bulletin attack in their own way.

episodes.name: Upstairs/Downstairs
episodes.overview: Dex reaches out to Julie but Fisk has other plans. Daredevil teams up with Ray to get the good on Dex, and Karen confront Fisk in his penthouse.

episodes.name: Revelations
episodes.overview: While Matt takes in the news of who his mother is, Karen prepares to run, Foggy gets some bad news from his brother, and Fisk tightens his fist on the NYC underworld.

episodes.name: Karen
episodes.overview: In the past, the reason behind Karen leaving home is revealed. In the present, Dex tracks Karen to the church and Daredevil tries to stop him.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: After the church slaughter, Ray has a decision to make and puts his family at risk. After Maggie gives him sanctuary, Matt meets with Karen and Foggy to decide on a plan of action against Fisk.

episodes.name: One Last Shot
episodes.overview: Vanessa returns to NYC but Fisk realizes that something is bothering her. Meanwhile, Murdock & Nelson represent a new client, but Fisk has anticipated their strategem.

episodes.name: A New Napkin
episodes.overview: As Fisk and Vanessa prepare for their wedding day, Daredevil makes a call to Dex that pushes him over the line.

title: The Punisher
overview: Ailesinin ölümünden sorumlu olan suçlular읜 peşini bırakmayan eski deniz piyadesi Frank Castle, New York yeraltı dünyasının ötesine uzanan derin bir askeri komployu ortaya çıkarır.

episodes.name: 3AM
episodes.overview: After he apparently dies, Frank tries to live peacefully but events overtake him. Meanwhile, an ICE agent tries to track down a U.S. military heroin ring.

episodes.name: Two Dead Men
episodes.overview: The elusive whistleblower known as Micro contacts Frank, who tracks Micro back to the family that believes he's dead. Meanwhile, Karen does some research for Frank, and Dinah goes on a date with Billy Russo.

episodes.name: Kandahar
episodes.overview: While Frank questions Micro about his intentions, he remembers what happened in Kandahar as part of Operation Cerberus.

episodes.name: Resupply
episodes.overview: Frank goes after arms dealers, and discovers that Dinah and her team are after them as well. Meanwhile, Sarah gets a return visit from Frank, and Dinah gets a visit from her mentor.

episodes.name: Gunner
episodes.overview: Frank and Micro track down Gunner, and Frank goes to see his old friend and learn if he knows who Agent Orange is. Meanwhile, Dinah lies under oath to cover up Frank's involvement,and Karen reaches out to Frank after Dinah interviews her.

episodes.name: The Judas Goat
episodes.overview: After Frank is injured, Micro turns to Curtis for help. Meanwhile, Dinah asks Billy if he knows that Frank is alive, and Lewis learns where O'Connor served.

episodes.name: Crosshairs
episodes.overview: Clay tries to give his son Lewis some advice. Meanwhile, Frank attacks Bennett but it's a ruse to get Bennett to lead them to Agent Orange.

episodes.name: Cold Steel
episodes.overview: After paying his mother a visit, Billy tells Dinah about his childhood. Meanwhile, Dinah sets a trap for the person who has bugged her office, while Micro and Frank discuss strategy.

episodes.name: Front Toward Enemy
episodes.overview: Lewis declares war on the government and anyone who supports it, and sends his manifesto to Karen. Meanwhile, Dinah considers what to say at Sam's service, or whether she should say anything at all.

episodes.name: Virtue of the Vicious
episodes.overview: Lewis goes after Ori and Frank tries to stop him. Afterward, Detective Sergeant Mahoney tries to piece together what happened. Meanwhile, Dinah tells Hernandez what really happened that got Sam and the others killed.

episodes.name: Danger Close
episodes.overview: Billy captures Sarah and Zach, and sends a squad of mercenaries to the power station. Frank is waiting. Meanwhile, Dinah meets with Billy and then Marion.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: Frank gives Dinah what she wants, and she learns that he murdered her former partner. Meanwhile, Micro and Frank make a deal to get Sarah and Zach back, but one of them is killed in the process.

episodes.name: Memento Mori
episodes.overview: Billy escapes capture and takes hostages to force Frank to come to him for a final showdown.

episodes.name: Roadhouse Blues
episodes.overview: Frank stops at a roadhouse and makes a new friend, and soon gets involved in trouble when thugs come after a young girl who may or may not want his protection.

episodes.name: Fight or Flight
episodes.overview: Frank and Amy end up in a motel room together, but the people after Amy get information on Frank from Beth and come after him. Meanwhile, Dinah pays Billy another visit in the hospital.

episodes.name: Trouble the Water
episodes.overview: Pilgrim and his men launch an attack on the station to get Frank, and Frank tries to convince Sheriff Hardin to let him help.

episodes.name: Scar Tissue
episodes.overview: Frank and Billy both visit some old associates, while Amy remembers some of the circumstances that put her on the run from Pilgrim.

episodes.name: One-Eyed Jacks
episodes.overview: Frank sets out to find out more about Konchevsky, and uses Turk Barrett as bait. Billy makes a new friend, and Krista goes to the window.

episodes.name: Nakazat
episodes.overview: Once Frank and Amy develop the photos, Frank goes after Poloznev. Billy goes after Curtis, and Mahoney goes after Dinay.

episodes.name: One Bad Day
episodes.overview: Frank and Curtis close in on Billy, who is preparing for his first robbery.

episodes.name: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.overview: Billy starts to remember the past after his encounter with Frank, and then makes an offer to the Boys. Curtis meets Amy for supper, and Frank pays a visit to his wife's grave.

episodes.name: Flustercluck
episodes.overview: Following Anderson's orders, Pilgrim puts a bounty on Frank and Amy's head. Amy turns to a friend for help, while Frank continues looking for Billy... who is paying a visit to Dinah.

episodes.name: The Dark Hearts of Men
episodes.overview: Frank goes after Billy, and Curtis and Pilgrim both end up with blood on their hands. Krista and Dinah talk about hells, and Krista realizes how Billy can break Frank.

episodes.name: The Abyss
episodes.overview: While Frank lies in custody, Dinah teams up with Karen Page to find out what really happened at the warehouse.

episodes.name: Collision Course
episodes.overview: Mahoney takes Frank for a ride, Pilgrim pays Curtis and Amy a visit, and Krista takes a fall for Billy.

episodes.name: The Whirlwind
episodes.overview: When Pilgrim abducts Amy and demands David's return, Pilgrim and Frank meet in final combat.

title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
overview: Jedi Düzeni'nin yıkılmasından ve öğrencisi Anakin Skywalker'ın Darth Vader'a dönüşmesinden on yıl sonra Tatooine'de saklanan Obi-Wan Kenobi, kaçırılan genç Prenses Leia'yı kurtarmak için tehlikeli bir göreve çıkar.

episodes.name: Part I
episodes.overview: When agents of the Empire pose a new threat, Obi-Wan Kenobi emerges after years of hiding.

episodes.name: Part II
episodes.overview: On a dangerous crime-ridden world, Obi-Wan becomes a target.

episodes.name: Part III
episodes.overview: Obi-Wan searches for allies as he attracts the attention of the Empire, threatening the locals.

episodes.name: Part IV
episodes.overview: Obi-Wan Kenobi plots a daring mission into enemy territory.

episodes.name: Part V
episodes.overview: Obi-Wan plans his next move as the Imperial forces attempt to draw him out.

episodes.name: Part VI
episodes.overview: Obi-Wan is drawn into a confrontation with Vader, as Luke's fate hangs in the balance.

title: Game of Thrones
overview: Yazların on yıllarca, kışların ise bir ömür sürebildiği Westeros topraklarında, Yedi Krallık'ın Demir Taht'ını ele geçirmek için soylu hanedanlar arasında ölümcül bir iktidar savaşı başlar.

episodes.name: Winter is Coming
episodes.overview: Lord Eddard Stark, ruler of the North, is summoned to court by his old friend, King Robert Baratheon, to serve as the King's Hand. Eddard reluctantly agrees after learning of a possible threat to the King's life. Eddard's bastard son Jon Snow must make a painful decision about his own future, while in the distant east Viserys Targaryen plots to reclaim his father's throne, usurped by Robert, by selling his sister in marriage.

episodes.name: The Kingsroad
episodes.overview: An incident on the Kingsroad threatens Eddard and Robert's friendship. Jon and Tyrion travel to the Wall, where they discover that the reality of the Night's Watch may not match the heroic image of it.

episodes.name: Lord Snow
episodes.overview: Jon Snow attempts to find his place amongst the Night's Watch. Eddard and his daughters arrive at King's Landing.

episodes.name: Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things
episodes.overview: Tyrion stops at Winterfell on his way home and gets a frosty reception from Robb Stark. Eddard's investigation into the death of his predecessor gets underway.

episodes.name: The Wolf and the Lion
episodes.overview: Catelyn's actions on the road have repercussions for Eddard. Tyrion enjoys the dubious hospitality of the Eyrie.

episodes.name: A Golden Crown
episodes.overview: Viserys is increasingly frustrated by the lack of progress towards gaining his crown.

episodes.name: You Win or You Die
episodes.overview: Eddard's investigations in King's Landing reach a climax and a dark secret is revealed.

episodes.name: The Pointy End
episodes.overview: Tyrion joins his father's army with unexpected allies. Events in King's Landing take a turn for the worse as Arya's lessons are put to the test.

episodes.name: Baelor
episodes.overview: Catelyn must negotiate with the irascible Lord Walder Frey.

episodes.name: Fire and Blood
episodes.overview: Daenerys must realize her destiny. Jaime finds himself in an unfamiliar predicament.

episodes.name: The North Remembers
episodes.overview: War grips the continent of Westeros. As Tyrion Lannister tries to take his strong-willed nephew in hand in King's Landing, Stannis Baratheon launches his own campaign to take the Iron Throne with the help of a mysterious priestess. In the east, Daenerys must lead her retinue through a desolate wasteland whilst beyond the Wall the Night's Watch seeks the aid of a wildling.

episodes.name: The Night Lands
episodes.overview: Stannis uses Ser Davos to seek out new allies for his war with the Lannisters. On the road north, Arya confides in Gendry. Robb Stark sends Theon Greyjoy to win an alliance with his father and the fierce warriors of the Iron Islands. Cersei and Tyrion clash on how to rule in King's Landing.

episodes.name: What is Dead May Never Die
episodes.overview: Catelyn Stark treats with King Renly in the hope of winning an alliance. Tyrion undertakes a complex plan in King's Landing to expose an enemy. At Winterfell, Bran's dreams continue to trouble him.

episodes.name: Garden of Bones
episodes.overview: Tyrion attempts to restrain Joffrey's cruelty. Catelyn attempts to broker a peace between Stannis and Renly. Daenerys and her followers arrive at the great city of Qarth and hope to find refuge there. Arya and Gendry arrive at Harrenhal, a great castle now under Lannister occupation.

episodes.name: The Ghost of Harrenhal
episodes.overview: Confusion rages in the Stormlands in the wake of a devastating reversal. Catelyn must flee with a new ally, whilst Littlefinger sees an opportunity in the chaos. Theon seeks to prove himself to his father in battle. Arya receives a promise from the enigmatic Jaqen H'ghar. The Night's Watch arrives at the Fist of the First Men. Daenerys Targaryen receives a marriage proposal.

episodes.name: The Old Gods and the New
episodes.overview: Arya has a surprise visitor; Dany vows to take what is hers; Joffrey meets his subjects; Qhorin gives Jon a chance to prove himself.

episodes.name: A Man Without Honor
episodes.overview: Jaime meets a relative; Theon hunts; Dany receives an invitation.

episodes.name: The Prince of Winterfell
episodes.overview: Theon holds the fort; Arya calls in her debt with Jaqen; Robb is betrayed; Stannis and Davos approach their destination.

episodes.name: Blackwater
episodes.overview: A massive battle rages for control of King's Landing and the Iron Throne.

episodes.name: Valar Morghulis
episodes.overview: Tyrion awakens to a changed situation. King Joffrey doles out rewards to his subjects. As Theon stirs his men to action, Luwin offers some final advice. Brienne silences Jaime; Arya receives a gift from Jaqen; Dany goes to a strange place; Jon proves himself to Qhorin.

episodes.name: Valar Dohaeris
episodes.overview: Jon is brought before Mance Rayder, the King Beyond the Wall, while the Night's Watch survivors retreat south. In King's Landing, Tyrion asks for his reward. Littlefinger offers Sansa a way out. Cersei hosts a dinner for the royal family. Daenerys sails into Slaver's Bay.

episodes.name: Dark Wings, Dark Words

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Body
episodes.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
episodes.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
episodes.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter One: MADMAX
episodes.overview: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
episodes.overview: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
episodes.overview: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
episodes.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. "Bob the Brain" tackles a difficult problem.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Spy
episodes.overview: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
episodes.overview: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
episodes.overview: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Gate
episodes.overview: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

episodes.name: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.overview: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
episodes.overview: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
episodes.overview: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flayed
episodes.overview: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

episodes.overview: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

episodes.overview: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
episodes.overview: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
episodes.overview: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
episodes.overview: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

episodes.overview: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

episodes.overview: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Dive
episodes.overview: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
episodes.overview: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: Papa
episodes.overview: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
episodes.overview: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

episodes.overview: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of Holly Wheeler
episodes.overview: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
episodes.overview: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

episodes.overview: The gang hatches an electrifying plan to reconnect Will to the hive mind. Tensions flare during a search of the Upside Down's Hawkins Lab.

episodes.overview: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.

title: Sherlock
overview: Arthur Conan Doyle'un klasik dedektiflik hikayelerinin modern Londra uyarlamasında, dahi danışman dedektif Sherlock Holmes ve ortağı Dr. John Watson en karmaşık suçları çözer.

episodes.name: A Study in Pink
episodes.overview: A war hero, invalided home from Afghanistan, meets a strange but charismatic genius who is looking for a flatmate - it is London in 2010, and Dr Watson and Sherlock Holmes are meeting for the first time. A string of impossible suicides has Scotland Yard baffled - and only one man can help.

episodes.name: The Blind Banker
episodes.overview: A mysterious cipher is being scrawled on the walls around London. The first person to see the cipher is dead within hours of reading it. Sherlock plunges into a world of codes and symbols, consulting with London's best graffiti artists. He soon learns that the city is in the grip a gang of international smugglers, a secret society called the Black Lotus.

episodes.name: The Great Game
episodes.overview: A strange clue in an empty room, a blood-soaked car, a priceless Old Master, a deranged bomber. With the clock ticking, the curtain rises on a battle of wits between Sherlock, John and the shadowy stranger who seems to know all the answers...

episodes.name: A Scandal in Belgravia
episodes.overview: Rejoin the 21st-century team of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson as they battle the worst that modern criminality has to offer.

episodes.name: The Hounds of Baskerville
episodes.overview: Watch Sherlock and Watson pursue information about research on genetically engineered animals for military use.

episodes.name: The Reichenbach Fall
episodes.overview: Watch as Moriarty poses the "final problem" and a tabloid reporter reveals the "shocking truth" about Sherlock.

episodes.name: The Empty Hearse
episodes.overview: 'Just one more miracle, Sherlock. Stop being dead.' Two years after the devastating events of The Reichenbach Fall, Dr John Watson has got on with his life. New horizons, romance and a comforting domestic future beckon. But with London under threat of a huge terrorist attack, Sherlock Holmes is about to rise from the grave with all the theatricality that comes so naturally to him. It's what his best friend wanted more than anything, but for John Watson it might well be a case of 'be careful what you wish for!' If Sherlock thinks everything will be just as he left it, though, he is in for a very big surprise...

episodes.name: The Sign of Three
episodes.overview: Sherlock faces his biggest challenge of all - delivering a best man's speech on John's wedding day.

episodes.name: His Last Vow
episodes.overview: Sherlock goes after publishing magnate and blackmailer Charles Magnussen, one of the most despicable criminals that he has ever encountered.

episodes.name: The Six Thatchers
episodes.overview: While waiting for Moriarty to make good on his beyond-the-grave threat, Sherlock is intrigued by cases of vandalism where the criminal is breaking open busts of Margaret Thatcher. He soon discovers that the vandalism is tied to Mary's past.

episodes.name: The Lying Detective
episodes.overview: To save John, Sherlock takes on the most dangerous case of his career: bring serial killer and milliionaire-philanthropist Culverton Smith to justice. Meanwhile, the mystery of Sherringford Holmes deepens.

episodes.name: The Final Problem
episodes.overview: Sherlock and John confirm that Eurus is still alive, and go to Sherringford to meet with her. However, they soon discover that it is all part of Eurus' master plan.

title: Peaky Blinders
overview: Birinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında İngiltere'nin Birmingham kentinde, hırslı ve zeki suç lideri Tommy Shelby önderliğindeki Peaky Blinders çetesinin yükseliş hikayesi.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Birmingham, 1919. Thomas Shelby controls the Peaky Blinders, one of the city's most feared criminal organisations, but his ambitions go beyond running the streets. When a crate of guns goes missing, Thomas recognises an opportunity to move up in the world.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Birmingham, 1919. Thomas Shelby controls the Peaky Blinders, one of the city's most feared criminal organisations, but his ambitions go beyond running the streets. Thomas fixes a horserace, provoking the ire of local kingpin Billy Kimber. He also starts a war with gypsy family the Lees. Meanwhile, Inspector Campbell carries out a vicious raid of Small Heath in search of the stolen guns.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Thomas Shelby plans to go to Cheltenham races in order to get closer to Billy Kimber. Knowing the gangster's appetite for beautiful women, Thomas invites Grace to accompany him. Meanwhile some IRA sympathisers approach Thomas with an offer to buy the stolen guns.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Thomas Shelby's war with the Lee family of gypsies escalates and Campbell puts further pressure on him to deliver the stolen guns. Meanwhile, Thomas's brother John plans to marry a former prostitute, but Thomas suspects that she's still on the game.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Thomas Shelby has to deal with an IRA chief who has come to Small Heath to avenge his cousin's death. Meanwhile, Campbell gets closer to the stolen guns, and Grace has to decide whether her loyalties lie with him or with Thomas.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As Thomas Shelby prepares to oust Billy Kimber, hidden secrets are revealed and the family have to face up to the problems that have divided them. Meanwhile, Campbell, obsessed with taking down the Peaky Blinders, unleashes one last plan to destroy them.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: As the 1920s begin to roar, business is booming for the Peaky Blinders gang. Tommy Shelby starts to expand his legal and illegal operations, with an eye on the racetracks of the south. Meanwhile, an enemy from Tommy's past returns to Birmingham.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Tommy offers to help Polly by searching for her children, who long ago were taken from her. In London, Tommy risks his life by meeting enigmatic leader Alfie Solomons. Meanwhile Arthur continues to feel the devastating effects of the Great War.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Tommy hatches a plan to take control of the southern racecourses. He also meets the aristocratic May Carleton and sees an opportunity to move up in the world. Meanwhile both Major Campbell and London gangster Darby Sabini plan Tommy's downfall.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Tommy finds out exactly what mission Major Campbell is forcing him to undertake. Arthur spearheads a ferocious takeover of London's Eden Club. Meanwhile, Polly's son Michael is welcomed into the business and quickly experiences the dark side of the Peaky Blinders.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Tommy is caught by surprise when his powerbase in London is obliterated. As Tommy struggles to save his family and regain the upper hand, May expresses her feelings for him, and he is paid a visit by an old friend.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As derby day arrives, Tommy is faced with impossible decisions as he plans to strike back at his enemies and take the family business to another level. Meanwhile, Major Campbell has one final card to play - one that he is certain will bring about Tommy's demise.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: It is Thomas Shelby's long-awaited wedding day. In the middle of the celebrations, a mysterious visitor imperils the entire Shelby family, and Tommy finds himself pulled into a web of intrigue more lethal than anything he has yet encountered.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Tommy discovers the extent of the mission given to him and the extreme lengths his new paymasters are willing to go to in their quest for power. Meanwhile his own family's activities lead to escalating danger in Birmingham.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Responding to the Italians' actions, Tommy is set on a path of deadly vengeance. Meanwhile, as he makes plans for his mission on behalf of the Russians, he realises there is a traitor in his midst.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Tommy and Tatiana play a personal and dangerous game to acquire information from one another, and Tommy finally comprehends the magnitude of Tatiana's warped ideals. Meanwhile, Polly reveals a dark secret, with terrible consequences for Tommy.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: As the Russians test the Peaky Blinders, Tommy realises that he is being seriously outmanoeuvred. But he has an ace up his sleeve in the form of an enemy turned ally - if only he can control him.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As Tommy prepares to commit the most audacious crime of his career, a blow is struck against him that could change everything. As he faces his worst fears, he needs his family more than ever - but who can he trust?

episodes.name: The Noose
episodes.overview: December 1925. Tommy Shelby OBE has acquired unprecedented legitimacy. The former gangster is also a man alone, estranged from his family and focused only on business. But when he receives a mysterious letter on Christmas Eve, Tommy realises that the Shelbys are in danger of annihilation. As the enemy closes in, Tommy flees his country house and returns to the only safe place he knows: Small Heath, Birmingham, the slum where he grew up. Facing a more determined and sophisticated threat than ever before, the Shelby family must find a way to put differences aside, work together, take up arms and fight for survival...

episodes.name: Heathens
episodes.overview: As the Shelbys come to terms with the shocking events of Christmas Day, Tommy endeavours to unite his family. Until the current threat is dealt with, their only safe place is together in Small Heath. Johnny Dogs and Charlie set about arming the locals - everyone is now a Peaky bodyguard. Tommy enlists the help of tough Romany Gypsy Aberama Gold, who wants something unusual in return. Jessie Eden confronts Tommy about the workers' pay. She warns him that revolution is in the air, and when Tommy doesn't relent she calls his bluff. As the situation plays out, Tommy's factory manager tells him he has one more meeting - with a mysterious businessman from Paris. But what transpires is no ordinary meeting with no ordinary businessman...

episodes.name: Blackbird
episodes.overview: The Italians launch another attack on the Peaky Blinders. Tommy realises that the Shelbys need to evolve if they are to survive, but some of the family are reluctant to part with tradition. As the strike takes hold at the Lanchester factory, Tommy pays a personal visit to Jessie Eden, but he is outmanoeuvred when she reveals something she knows about his past. Changretta plots to continue the vendetta in the most devastating way possible.
